A paradigm shift in manufacturing technologies for industrial advancement
4 EXHIBITIONS

Coatingㅣ SurTech ㅣ Material ㅣ Testing Korea 2027 — from materials development to ultra-thin coating and surface treatment, process-specific inspection and performance testing: one vertically integrated platform for end-to-end manufacturing technologies.
2027 SPECIAL PAVILIONS
Three themed pavilions where materials, surface technologies and testing meet the industries that need them most.
01. AI & Automation Pavilion

A special pavilion gathering AI & automation exhibitors from all four shows, showcasing how machine vision and data analytics are replacing experience-based judgment in formulation, plating control, and defect inspection.
02. Thermal Solutions Pavilion
A specialized pavilion for THERMAL CONTROL materials, components & technologies-for high-heat electronic systems in the age of AI and electrification
03. Mobility Perception Sensor Pavilion
A special pavilion leading future mobility innovation by showcasing R&D and industrial advances in perception-sensor technologies and diverse services that use them.
TARGET BUYER MATCHING SERVICE

ADVANCED MATERIAL AND TECH WEEK KOREA, connecting advanced industries such as semiconductors, secondary batteries, and automotive electronics, is a B2B business hub where high-value purchasing and R&D demand comes together.

Select three preferred Korean buyers, and we guarantee at least one confirmed 1:1 business meeting with a matched buyer.
